title: 第540章 年终布道第539章 引光大典晨曦破晓
slug: 请不要给基础技能附魔奇怪的词条
content_zh:
第540章年终布道
枢机主教将牧杖立入露台中央的日轮支架。
杖头内的晨曦火种依旧在燃烧。
白金色绶带被悬崖上的风吹起，一行行祷文在晨光的照耀下璀璨生辉。
一名司祭修士捧着厚重书匣上前。
枢机主教打开书匣，从中取出一本以白色皮革装订的典籍。
【晨曦圣典】
圣典封面没有多少装饰，只在正中央嵌着一枚金色日轮。
枢机主教双手将圣典捧在身前。
他的手指翻开第一页。
笼罩整座枢机主教座堂的金白色光芒，忽然开始流动。
原本附着在尖塔、拱廊和石桥上的圣光缓缓脱离建筑，向主殿上空汇聚。
一片片光芒叠在一起。
先是裙摆，再是赤足。
洁白长裙在云海之上缓慢流动，像是被晨风吹起的薄纱。
女神的身躯一点点凝实。
祂赤足踏在金白色光辉上，左手轻轻护在胸前，右手高举一盏散发晨光的提灯。
形貌与各地光明教堂中供奉的神像没有区别。
只是更加庞大。
从第三层巡礼广场抬头望去，女神的仪式化身几乎与枢机主教座堂等高。

白裙边缘垂入云海。
身后的光芒则像一轮舒展开来的太阳，覆盖整座七层台地。
上万信众再次低下头。
“赞美晨曦。”
整齐的祷告声沿着白色悬崖向上涌来。
维克多也跟着抬头看了几眼。
不得不说，确实很像。
女神化身的五官由圣光构成，双眼明亮，却没有真正的视线。
祂不会转动眼眸。
也不会把注意力落在某一个人身上。
更没有那种真正神明降临时，直接压在灵魂深处的沉重感。
维克多是被光明女神本尊盯着看过的人。
仿品和本尊的区别，他应该算是很有发言权了。
眼前这个，明显只是仪式投影。
content_en:
Chapter 540 Year-End Sermon
The cardinal placed his pastoral staff into the sun disk bracket in the center of the terrace.
The morning fire in the head of the staff is still burning.
The white-gold ribbon was blown by the wind on the cliff, and the lines of prayers shone brightly in the morning light.
A priest and monk came forward holding a heavy book box.
The Cardinal opened the book box and took out a book bound in white leather.
【Morning Scripture】
There is not much decoration on the cover of the sacred book, except for a golden sun disk embedded in the center.
The Cardinal held the holy book in front of him in both hands.
His fingers turned to the first page.
The golden-white light that enveloped the entire Cardinal Cathedral suddenly began to flow.
The holy light originally attached to the spires, arcades and stone bridges slowly broke away from the buildings and converged towards the sky above the main hall.
Pieces of light are stacked together.
First the skirt, then the bare feet.
The white dress flows slowly above the sea of ​​clouds, like tulle blown by the morning breeze.
The goddess's body solidified little by little.
He stepped on the golden white light with his bare feet, his left hand gently protecting his chest, and his right hand holding high a lantern emitting morning light.
The appearance is no different from the statues enshrined in churches of light everywhere.
Just bigger.
Looking up from the third-floor parade square, the ceremonial incarnation of the goddess is almost as high as the Cardinal Cathedral.
The edge of the white skirt hangs into the sea of ​​clouds.
The light behind him was like an unfolding sun, covering the entire seven-story platform.
Thousands of believers bowed their heads again.
"Praise the morning light."
Uniform prayers flowed up the white cliff.
Victor also looked up a few times.
I have to say, it does look very similar.
The goddess's incarnation's facial features are made of holy light, and her eyes are bright, but have no real sight.
He does not turn His eyes.
Don't focus on any one person.
There is no such heavy feeling as when a true god comes, pressing directly into the depths of the soul.
Victor is someone who has been stared at by the goddess of light.
He should have a say in the difference between the imitation and the original product.
The one in front of me is obviously just a ritual projection.
